scientific_integrity: No independent validation has been claimed; proof and reproducible finite tests are provided, with explicit novelty and scope caveats.
scientific_limitations: Full order-preserving contractions of finite labeled chains; only idempotents; fixed tuple length for limiting laws. Existing idempotent cardinalities and the numerical pair-total sequence are prior material. Inaccessible 2023 partial-contraction full text and equivalent interval-graph terminology remain priority risks. Exhaustive computation is finite and not an independent proof.
title: Commuting idempotent bands and an all-arity product-rank law for monotone contractions
